name: dashboarr
description: Dashboarr is a native mobile app (Android & iOS) that connects directly to your self-hosted *arr stack and media services. No backend server required — the app talks to each service's REST API using your API keys.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: Public URL your phone will use to reach the backend. When set the pairing QR encodes both the URL and token so the app can pair in a single scan. When omitted the QR only contains the token and you enter the URL manually in the app.

variables.name: OFFLINE_THRESHOLD
variables.description: Consecutive failed health checks (30s each) before

variables.name: BACKEND_USE_REMOTE
variables.description: Route service polls via remoteUrl instead of localUrl. The app's own useRemote flag is always ignored server-side. Default false (backend on LAN). Flip to true only if the backend lives off-LAN.

variables.name: TRUST_PROXY
variables.description: Enable if behind a reverse proxy (Caddy, Nginx, Traefik) so rate limiting uses the real client IP from X-Forwarded-For.
